title: Percents
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.rat.percent.convert: Percent means out of 100. To go from percent to decimal, divide by 100 (point 2 places left); the other way, multiply by 100.
hints.rat.percent.of: Change the percent to a decimal (or a fraction), then multiply: 25% of 80 = 0.25 × 80.
hints.rat.percent.what-percent: Write part over whole as a fraction, change it to a decimal, then multiply by 100.
hints.rat.percent: Percent means out of 100. Of means multiply. What percent? Part over whole, times 100.

misconceptionMessages.rat.percent-place: Percent means out of 100: move the point 2 places. 7% = 0.07, and 0.4 = 40%.
misconceptionMessages.rat.percent-not-converted: 35% and 0.35 are the same amount: 35 hundredths. Move the point 2 places when you change between them.
misconceptionMessages.rat.percent-digits: The fraction's numbers aren't the percent. Make it out of 100: 3/5 = 60/100 = 60%.
misconceptionMessages.rat.percent-not-hundred: Remember percent is out of 100: 25% of 80 is 25 × 80 ÷ 100 = 20.
misconceptionMessages.rat.percent-flipped: Part over whole: 12 out of 48 is 12/48, not 48/12. It should be less than 100% when the part is smaller.
misconceptionMessages.rat.percent-part-as-percent: The part isn't the percent unless the whole is 100. Divide part by whole, then multiply by 100.

sections.title: Percents, decimals and fractions
sections.objective: Change between percents, decimals and fractions.
explain: Percent to decimal: divide by 100. Decimal to percent: multiply by 100.
sections.key: Percent means out of 100. 35% = 35/100 = 0.35. Move the point 2 places.

sections.title: A percent of a number
sections.objective: Find a percent of a number, like 15% of 60.
sections.key: Change the percent to a decimal or fraction, then multiply. 25% of 80 = {1/4} of 80 = 20.

sections.title: What percent?
sections.objective: Find what percent one number is of another.
explain: Part over whole is the fraction. Change it to a percent.
sections.key: Write part over whole, change it to a decimal, then multiply by 100.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Percent means out of 100. Of means multiply. What percent? Part over whole, times 100.
